title: Amelia | Patchwork Shirt with Stripes, Dots and Colour Blocks
bodyHtml:
This is the shirt that announces itself before you even say hello. The patchwork mix of stripes, dots and colour blocks in hot pink, forest green, tangerine and purple creates a joyful, unapologetic visual moment—perfect for anyone who dresses without apology. The relaxed fit and soft, flowing silhouette move with you all day, bringing that effortless energy only truly original pieces can deliver. Wear it to catch-ups with mates, weekend markets, sundowners or anywhere you want to be the brightest thing in the room.

Why you'll love it

  • Patchwork design mixing stripes, dots and colour blocks in pink, green, orange and purple—wearable art that sparks conversation
  • Mix of playful motifs creates genuine personality without trying too hard
  • Relaxed, skimming fit gives you total freedom to move and breathe all day
  • Light and breathable—stays fresh and comfortable through warm days and casual evenings
  • Works beautifully with white trousers or a simple skirt, letting the shirt do all the talking
  • Perfect for coffee dates, weekend rambles, summer outings or anywhere you want to make an impression
  • Genuinely hard to find—this exact blend of pattern and colour doesn't come around often
